reasoning: The icon shows four corner brackets around an inner rectangle, the standard UI glyph for screen capture, camera viewfinder focus, or fit-to-frame. While abstract UI chrome on its own, it serves well as a concrete icon for screenshot, screen-grab, and camera framing tasks, though it is easily confused with fullscreen or generic scan icons.
